name: Science Practice Content Assessment #2 MG KAAC

questions.text: These particles are said to possess "flavors." What elementary particles make up protons and neutrons?
Phosphorus possesses several of these, including the red, white, and violet types. What refers to an element that has different forms?
Halogens are Group 17 on the Periodic Table. Which of the following is NOT a halogen? arsenic, astatine, iodine, fluorine

During the Haber process, nitrogen and hydrogen react to form ammonia. However, this reaction is reluctant to occur and requires the presence of iron oxide to speed up the reaction. What is a substance that speeds up a reaction by lowering its activation energy?

The diagram shows a spaceman using a rocket backpack to fly forward in space. This thrust of the rocket occurs in one direction, and the movement of the spaceman is in the opposite direction. Which of Newton's laws best explains how the spaceman moves by this method?
You push a 50-kg crate across the floor with 10 newtons of force. If you push the crate a total of 5 meters, how much work was done on the crate?

A 2-kg mass moves along a frictionless surface at 1 m/s and collides with a second 2-kg mass that is at rest. If the two objects stick together in a perfectly inelastic collision, how fast will the combined masses move after the collision?
In the diagram, a circuit has three resistors in series in which R1 is a 2-ogm resistor, R2 is a 4-ohm resistor, and R3 is a 3-ohm resistor. What is the total resistance in this circuit?
